setup: DRG Survivor running. Part A: no plugin reload after launch. Part B: after a plugin reload with the game still running. Opened and closed with GUIDE+A.

seen.part_A: First chord open: ring on the tab bar. Then 6 close/reopens: focus ring ABSENT 6/6 at about 1 s. document.hasFocus() true; activeElement was Decky's own tab strip / the plugin tab bar (div[role=tab] main, rect [130,136,68,34]). One Down press put the ring on the chat row every time.
seen.part_B: After reload: 6/6 reopens had the ring PRESENT on the Main tab bar (rect 48,64,300,20) and hasFocus true.

verdict: Diagnostic only. Ring behaviour on reopen differs before vs after a plugin reload while a game runs: absent 6/6 without reload, present 6/6 after reload. hasFocus was true in both, so focus loss is not the cause in part A.
